summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Babel preset but its package.json declares a preinstall lifecycle hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fetches the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated in obfuscator.io style (hex-mangled identifiers, per-call rotating property dictionaries) to hide the fetch/extract/exec flow. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line CJS bundle prefixed `// @bun @bun-cjs` whose contents are hex-mangled identifiers and a scrambled constants-array string rotator. Its behavior is unrelated to the declared Babel preset in lib/index.js. Using a second runtime to execute an opaque obfuscated blob on `npm install` combines obfuscated lifecycle code, an alternate-runtime dropper, and a declared-purpose mismatch — a Babel preset has no legitimate need for the Bun runtime or a 727 KB obfuscated companion.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
